summary: Engineer Diary & Admin Dispatch Board (Phase 4) testing complete. Backend 5/5 tests passing. Frontend pages load correctly via client-side navigation. All core features working: Week/Day toggle, navigation, block creation/deletion, slot drawer, dispatch board with engineer list.

integration_issues.issue: Direct URL navigation redirects to /dashboard. Must use client-side navigation (pushState) after login. This is expected React SPA behavior where user state may not be available on initial page load.

critical_code_review_comments: Code quality is good - proper data-testid attributes on all interactive elements
API endpoints follow RESTful conventions and return proper error codes
Frontend components have proper loading states and error handling
seed_data_creation: Test blocks created during UI testing (Test Training Block, Annual leave)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Engineer Diary and Admin Dispatch Board features fully tested. Backend APIs: GET /api/svc/engineer/diary, POST /api/svc/engineer/diary/blocks, DELETE /api/svc/engineer/diary/blocks/{id}, POST /api/svc/engineer/diary/case/{id}/reschedule, GET /api/svc/admin/diary/unassigned, POST /api/svc/admin/diary/case/{id}/assign. Frontend pages: /svc/engineer/diary (engineer week+day view), /service-desk/dispatch (admin dispatch board). Note: Direct URL navigation requires client-side routing after login.

backend: POST /api/svc/engineer/diary/blocks - creates block, appears in GET diary
POST /api/svc/engineer/diary/case/{id}/reschedule - updates scheduled_at, 403 if not assigned
GET /api/svc/admin/diary/unassigned - lists open cases without scheduled_at or engineer
frontend: Add block modal opens, creates block, shows success toast
Slot drawer opens on click, shows delete button for blocks
Shows 'All caught up' when no unassigned jobs
Engineers list shows with Pick buttons
